input.prompt:
3D Pixar-style animated film, vertical 9:16, cinematic golden-hour lighting, shallow depth of field, rich detail. Characters: the small green frog Fizz (image 1) with sly half-closed amber eyes and a big smirk, and the caramel bunny (image 2) with one floppy ear and a green knitted scarf. Setting: the sunny pond clearing (image 3). Keep both characters exactly as in the reference images in every shot, never stretching or changing proportions. A comedic 15-second story in 4 quick cinematic shots with hard cuts.
Shot 1 (0-4s): low-angle close shot, Fizz grins slyly as he grips a long thick green vine with both hands and leans back, pulling it tight like a giant slingshot, the vine creaking and stretching, his round belly puffing with effort; the bunny watches nervously from the side holding the vine's other end.
Shot 2 (4-7s): wide side shot, the vine snaps forward with a loud twang and Fizz is launched into the air in a graceful arc across the pond, ears-flapping bunny spinning in the recoil, water ripples below.
Shot 3 (7-11s): tracking shot following Fizz flying across the pond past dragonflies and reeds, cheeks rippling in the wind, then he crashes with a comic splat into a big chili bush with red chilies, leaves exploding around him.
Shot 4 (11-15s): close-up, Fizz pops his head out of the bush with a chili in his mouth and leaves on his head, winks sly at the camera, while far behind him the bunny throws her paws up in disbelief.
Sound design only, absolutely no music: dense layered ambience (birds, wind, pond water, insects), creaking stretching vine, a loud twang, whoosh of flight, a wet splat and rustling leaves, a crisp chili crunch, tiny comic boing and squeak accents synced to the motion.
